papers.title: Accurate Residues for Floating-Point Debugging
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2604.06258v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Floating-point arithmetic is error-prone and unintuitive. Floating-point debuggers instrument programs to monitor floating-point arithmetic at run time and flag numerical issues. They estimate residues, i.e., the difference between actual floating-point and ideal real values, for every floating-point value in the program. Prior work explores various approaches for computing these residues accurately and efficiently. Unfortunately, the most efficient methods, based on "error-free transformations", have a high rate of false reports, while the most accurate methods, based on high-precision arithmetic, are very slow.
